notes.title: THE FINAL UPDATE + WHAT NOW!?
notes.notes:
Greetings,


Well, this is it, my final update for this game! It has been a pleasure to work on this game, but do not fret, as I will still be making games in the future. After working on this game for about a year now, from its early access phase (which was pretty bare bones at that point) to a fully finished game! I couldn't have done it without some of the people helping me work on this project; my dream game wouldn't be the same without them! 


What's new? 
Fixed player breathing (sprinting works now)

Fixed the AI to have breathing as well (including footsteps) 


So What Now!?
I am going to plan out a new game idea, and maybe some other projects that do not have anything to do with video games. Nonetheless, another project will be a game, but who knows how long it will take? I will not do another early access phase for my next game; I have learned my lesson from this one. If I do decide to make it into early access, I'll be sure to have a lot more stuff in the game than having it bare bones and empty with barely any features. If you'd like to keep up to date, make sure to follow me on my Twitter/X page, I'm more active there than anywhere else, to be honest! 



Thank you, everyone, for those who kept in check when the game was still in its infancy, and for those who are new to my game and want to try it out! My journey of game development is only the beginning of what is to come!



God bless you all!

~HBunny

notes.title: Major Update OUT NOW & MORE!
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone! 

It has been a while since my last post here. Well, the wait is finally over! Anomalous Deception UPDATE VERSION 3 is now finally out! This also means the game is now in FULL RELEASE! 

This does not mean that I am completely done with the game; there are still a few small things that I need to patch up before I fully move on to another project. The game is 100% complete with some minor bugs that won't interrupt the gameplay experience. 

Here's what's new on this update! 

Added: 
-Additional Level Generation
-AI Monster In That Said Level Generation
-UI interaction indicator
-More Collectibles (AKA Documents for the lore!)
-A Gun (Only For that Said Level Generation)
-Randomize Puzzles (Only For That Said Level)
-Two More Endings (Which will surprise you!)
-An End Credits 

Fixed:
-Difficulty Balance

Removed: 
-Early Access Popup (From Main Menu)
-Launcher

I do plan to polish up the game once more, then it'll be another project, for which I have some ideas in mind! I can't say what it's going to be, but I do kinda want to make a story-focused type of gameplay like how SOMA does it. 

We will see what the future holds, but until then, enjoy this game in all its glory!

~HBunny

notes.title: Upcoming Major Update In The Future!
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone! 

I figured I should inform you of the next big update I plan to release soon. Hopefully. 

This upcoming major update will help finalize the game to be 100% complete!

I plan to add randomly generated puzzles for the game, including an extra randomized level as well! each room will serve its purpose for the player to complete the level, I have thoughts on adding a self-defense weapon for specifically that extra level I plan to add. 

Here's a preview of one of the puzzles I plan to add! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964787/7123f481dc1b3da5f760b6a3895d814c5060844f.gif

I also plan to update the interaction system a little bit, kinda like almost "amnesia/soma" kind of interactivity. Not much is promised but it will be planned to be added! 

I still plan to add the last two endings which will be made! 

I do plan to add more lore to the game which will vary on your completion of the gameplay. You'll like it since it tells more about the story. 

More will be opened up later on but for now, I'll keep my peace!

~HBunny

level reload error when water rises


This game's second phase is complete! The THIRD and FINAL update will make the game 100% complete!

~HBunny | Twitter/X | Youtube

notes.title: Release date being delayed once more! + QnA
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Please do not be alarmed that the game has not been released yet, we have yet to because we didn't have time to have a build ready for review, and it is in the process right now as we speak! 

The release date will now be; June, 4th, 2024!  If not later!

Do not worry though the game is stable and playable, we are just waiting until we can officially release the game for you guys! Honestly, it is my fault for planning the release time sooner rather than later. 

Rest assured I believe I have learned my lesson from this and will promise you that the game will be released at this current date! If anything it may be released earlier than that but the latest it will be is on the 4th of June!

QnA

-Question - Why make it early access?
-Answer - [spoiler]To potentially gain feedback and make improvements on my game![/spoiler]

-Question - Will the game have mod support? 
-Answer - [spoiler]The game will not but feel free to make it mod-supportive if you wish![/spoiler]

-Question - Is this game trash?
-Answer - [spoiler]What kind of question is that? No, in my biased opinion.[/spoiler]

-Question - Will there be lore/story in the game? 
-Answer - [spoiler]You'll just have to play the game yourself! ;)[/spoiler]

-Question - What's so offensive about this? 
-Answer - [spoiler]It has let's just say that it has one nazi symbol, which will restrict certain countries from playing this game.[/spoiler] 

-Question - When will the gameplay trailer be out?
-Answer - [spoiler] The Gameplay Trailer is out now![/spoiler]

Hopefully, that's everything, thank you guys for your patience and we will release it on the 4th of June!
~HBunny

notes.title: Release Date Delayed
notes.notes:
Greetings, 

Anomalous Deception is almost ready but we need more time to iron out the bugs before we release it for early access! 

The game's original release date was May 17th, 2024, but it is now delayed to May 31st, 2024! 

The game is playable and almost ready, but we need more time to fix some things, add a few more features, beta-test it, and get the game ready for release. Also do expect a gameplay trailer coming soon!

Please check out these links! Twitter/X, Youtube, Linktree, IndieDB

~HBunny
